```r
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install("path/to/L-Atelier/CAULDRON")
library(CAULDRON)
```

The required package list for this installation hasn't been fully set up yet — if you choose to use CAULDRON, you'll need to install packages as they're called by the functions you use. See the [Reference](../reference/index.html) page for what each function depends on.
